title.headline: Start your free trial
title.text: Download Search Guard and install it — your 60-day trial of every Enterprise and Compliance feature activates automatically. No registration, no license key, no credit card. Prefer the forever-free Community Edition? Same download.
step1.headline: Download Search Guard
step1.text: Download the Search Guard plugin matching the Elasticsearch version you are running — the version matrix shows exactly which Search Guard release fits which Elasticsearch release. The download is platform-independent.
step2.headline: Install Search Guard
step2.text: Stop your Elasticsearch cluster and install Search Guard on all nodes.
